name: Relatedness benchmark for determiners
description: Measures models' ability to capture the semantic contribution of determiners in compositional distributional semantics via relatedness judgments.
evaluation_method: correlation with human relatedness judgments (Spearman/Pearson correlation)
general_score_metric: Spearman (or Pearson) correlation with human judgments
reputation: A niche academic benchmark targeted at compositional semantics and determiners; limited adoption outside specialized semantics research.
notes: Small, focused dataset probing determiners' semantic contribution — not broad-coverage. Results can be sensitive to lexical overlap and dataset construction; not intended as a general LLM benchmark.
